segments.text: This is agnt: your coding agent's eyes and hands in a real browser. One bug report, taken from diagnosis to full end-to-end coverage — through the floating proxy UI.
The developer reports the bug in the floating panel — it goes straight over the proxy's channel to the agent, which picks it up and answers in the same overlay.

The agent runs layout diagnostics through the proxy. Five issues, each outlined on the page: the root cause is a translate-Z-zero hack creating a containing block that traps the pinned note. The CSS audit grades the damage.

The diagnosis becomes a site-wide regression check — red, five violations. The agent applies the fix, and the check runs green. And the fix holds: the export menu renders in full and takes clicks, and the note finally answers.
Finally, the dynamic form. The agent drives every failure condition end to end: a passing baseline, empty required fields, an invalid email, seats out of range.

Then the server-side failures: a duplicate company rejected with 409, a plan rule violation at 422, and a raw 500 surfaced to the user. Six failure-condition tests and one green baseline — generated, observed, and verified.
agnt. Give your agent the browser.
